title: FieldGuideRU-TRANSLATE
description: Translation of the FieldGuide mod into Russian!
body:
[EN] Project Description
Welcome to the official Russian translation resource pack for the Field Guide mod!

If you love diving deep into the mechanics of Minecraft but find it difficult to navigate all the features of the incredible Field Guide mod by developer evanbones due to the language barrier, this resource pack is exactly what you need. It provides a complete, high-quality, and contextually accurate localization into Russian.

✨ Key Features:
100% Full Translation: Every single line of text, guide entry, item description, and interface element added by the Field Guide mod is fully translated into Russian.

Contextual Accuracy: The translation has been carefully crafted and proofread to ensure it aligns perfectly with official Minecraft terminology and feels natural to native speakers.

Up-to-Date Support: Regular updates to keep up with the latest versions of the original mod.

🎮 How it impacts your user experience:
Seamless Gameplay: You no longer need to minimize the game or use external translators to understand complex guide entries or mod mechanics.

Deep Immersion: Read lore, guides, and tutorial sections directly in your native language, allowing for a much smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience.

Enhanced Accessibility: Perfect for players who want to fully master the Field Guide mod but prefer playing in Russian.

📦 Installation Guide:
Download this resource pack.

Place the downloaded .zip file into your Minecraft resourcepacks folder.

Open the game, go to Options -> Resource Packs, and move this pack to the top of the active list.

Make sure your game language is set to Русский (Россия).

Enjoy your fully translated game!

Note: This is a translation resource pack (localization addon). It requires the original Field Guide mod by evanbones to be installed.
